subject: general
question: Which of the following types of engine classification is based on cylinder arrangement?
solution:
The correct answer is __V-engine**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cylinder arrangement__ is one of the classifications of engines.
 
• The V-engine has cylinders arranged in a V-shape.
 
• This arrangement provides a compact design and reduces engine size.
 
• Compared to inline engines, V-engines offer better balance and smoother operation.
 
• They are commonly used in high-performance vehicles due to their efficiency and power delivery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Diesel Cycle Engine:**

 
 
• Operates on the Diesel cycle, which uses compression ignition.
 
• Used in heavy vehicles and industrial applications.
 
 
 
• **Dual Cycle Engine:**
 
 
• Combines features of both Otto and Diesel cycles.
 
• Used in situations requiring both efficiency and high power output.
 
 
 
• **Otto Cycle Engine:**
 
 
• Operates on the Otto cycle, using spark ignition.
 
• Commonly found in gasoline-powered vehicles.
